info.name: Georgia Digitization Platform - Backend API
info.description: Complete API collection for the Georgia Digitization Platform backend. This collection includes all endpoints for document processing, user management, file operations, system administration, and AI-powered search functionality. Updated with all missing endpoints including System routes, V2 API endpoints, and comprehensive GCS operations. Latest update includes: Rename File, Bulk Delete Files/Folders, List Root/Path Directory, List Destinations with Subfolders, List Destination Path, List With Subfolders, Search Files and Folders, Download Folders as ZIP, and Get User Transfers (Paginated) endpoints.
